summary: @ornikar/monorepo-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: This version of the package advertises itself as a lerna/eslint/tsconfig monorepo configuration helper but ships a hostile install-time execution chain. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`, and setup.mjs is an obfuscated launcher (`_0x...` variable/string-array style) that, when the `bun` binary is not on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled artifact (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose body is a rotating string-array dictionary with mangled identifiers (`function WV8StW(...){for(...)MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());...}`, `const n7gIxM=[...]`) — an obfuscated payload with no relationship to the package's advertised monorepo-config purpose. The alternate-runtime dispatch (fetch Bun, execute bundled Bun-compiled bytecode) is a scanner-evasion pattern: Node-only supply-chain scanners do not read Bun bytecode, so the payload's actual behavior is hidden behind the runtime fetch. Any developer or CI system running `npm install` for this version automatically executes attacker-controlled code on their machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
